heading: Loan feasibility
lead: The Secretary may not, as a condition of making a telephone loan to an applicant therefor, require the applicant to—

tree.text: increase the rates charged to the applicant’s customers or subscribers; or

children.text: net income or margins before interest; to
the interest requirements on all of the applicant’s outstanding and proposed loans.

notes.text: Amendments2018—Pub. L. 115–334 struck out “and the Governor of the telephone bank” after “The Secretary” in introductory provisions. 1994—Pub. L. 103–354 substituted “Secretary” for “Administrator”.
